scope: Independent six-turn paired cave diagnostics; 2560x1440 capture at60FPS, renderer capped144FPS,1334x750 rays. RMS compares each exposure-normalized wall crop with its own settled reference; not artifact counts or absolute quality. Post-capture8s static timing is not a performance-floor test. No diagnostic installed.

rr_reset.policy: Reset at interframe camera rotation>=5degrees and first following frame.
rr_reset.logging_limitation: Native stdout was discarded by the direct launcher. The enabled-logged repeat routes markers to retained stderr; only this repeat verifies activation.
rr_reset.decision: Rejected: confirmed resets provide no meaningful post-turn convergence gain. No production changes.

cache_density.decision: Reject factor3 as a noise treatment: confirmed denser cache update increases GPU cost without improving six-turn convergence. These capped static timing tails are pass-cost observations, not minimum-FPS tests.
cache_density.initial_invalid_attempt: Java discarded the undeclared native setting. Initial data cannot establish density effect. Verified pair exposes the option in modules/ray_tracing.yaml and confirms saved5/3 plus changed GPU cost.

opposite_view.decision: Reject as a cave-noise treatment: no useful gain from spending one quarter of the fixed update budget on the opposite view. Diagnostic never installed; live shader source restored.

allocation_audit.counter_method: Atomic counters in unused lock-buffer words, displayed as binary cells through RR and tone mapping. Settled failure cells decoded without ambiguous intensities; this is not raw buffer readback.
allocation_audit.finding: Allocation failure path exists and was exercised before the capture. The displayed failure total did not increase across this six-turn cave capture; no evidence here ties it to the reported rapid-turn spots.
allocation_audit.source_issue: HashMapInsert sets cacheIndex=0 on allocation failure; HashMapInsertEntry ignores its false result and returns that unrelated slot. The ordinary invalid-index guards do not catch slot0. A targeted correctness fix remains to be implemented/tested.
